subject: Re: Request — Lexicon Health: decommission & proof bundle for prompt outputs/logs
messages:
From: Jane Doe <security@lexiconhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request — Lexicon Health: purge of prompt outputs + logs (retention ID: LX-ER-2026-01)

Hi Marcus,

Per our compliance review (retention ID LX-ER-2026-01), Lexicon is requesting a full decommission of all prompt artifacts, generation outputs, and associated inference logs for the dataset scoped under PO 1298 (project: clinical-qna). Specifically we need: 
- All prompt inputs and generation outputs (raw and derivative)
- Inference request/response logs and tracing metadata (last 24 months)
- Any KV-cache or prefix caches related to the project
- Audit trails referencing user identifiers that were part of the dataset

We require a signed proof bundle (manifest with checksums, redacted screenshots if needed, and an ops ticket) demonstrating the purge was completed. Our legal team has asked for completion within 72 hours from receipt of a feasible runbook.

Please confirm: 1) the proposed timeline, 2) the regions where artifacts currently reside (we expect us-east-1), and 3) the format of the proof bundle.

Thanks,
Jane Doe
Senior Security Analyst
Lexicon Health
security@lexiconhealth.com

Attachments referenced: lexicon_po_1298.pdf (PO sent separately via DocuSign)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <security@lexiconhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request — Lexicon Health: purge of prompt outputs + logs (retention ID: LX-ER-2026-01)

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear scope. We can run this as an expedited decommission. High-level plan below; Marissa from Ops is on the thread to kick off scheduling and the execution checklist.

Planned steps (summary):
1) Confirm residency: perform automated inventory of S3 buckets, KV partitions, and model-serving caches mapped to PO 1298.
2) Create a runbook ticket (INF-7421) and snapshot manifests for each artifact type.
3) Execute deletion in a maintenance window (preferably a 2-hour window) that you approve. Deletions include object-level removal + final lifecycle hooks to drop derived caches.
4) Produce a proof bundle: CSV manifest with pre/post SHA256 checksums (pre-deletion placeholders where allowed), ops ticket PDF, and redacted screenshot(s) showing KV cache flush.
5) Provide signed confirmation (I will countersign on Redwood letterhead) and keep the ticket open for 30 days for audit queries.

Questions for Lexicon:
- Can you confirm that all identifiers tied to the retention scope are covered (list already shared with us), and that we should target us-east-1 only? If any EU/other regions are in scope please flag now.
- Do you require a cryptographic hash of deleted objects or is a checksum manifest + ops confirmation sufficient?

I've attached a draft runbook and a proof template for your review. If that looks good we'll schedule a run with Marissa.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_deletion_runbook_v1.pdf, redwood_proof_template.csv

Subject: Re: Request — Lexicon Health: purge of prompt outputs + logs (retention ID: LX-ER-2026-01)

Hi all — Ops here. We completed the inventory and confirm the following artifact locations are in-scope (mapped to PO 1298):
- s3://redwood-prod-logs/lexicon/clinical-qna/ (objects dated 2024-02 through 2026-01)
- s3://redwood-artifacts/lexicon/po_1298/outputs/ (derivatives + compressed batches)
- kv-cache cluster: kv-cluster-a, partitions: lexicon_1298_* (ephemeral caches on us-east-1)
- inference tracing: tracing-db.redwood.internal (retention subset exported to s3 path above)

Proposed maintenance window: Wed 2026-02-11 02:00-04:00 PST (we can shift to 20:00-22:00 if that is less disruptive for your engineers). Expected execution time: ~45 minutes plus manifest generation.

Execution checklist (excerpt):
- Create runbook ticket (INF-7421) -> created (see link)
- Snapshot object list and compute per-object SHA256 for manifest (pre-delete) -> stored in secure bucket
- Execute object removal + verify 404s on sampled keys
- Flush KV caches and take redacted screenshots of cache state pre/post
- Archive proof bundle to secure S3 with restricted access and send manifest + ops_ticket PDF to Lexicon legal

We will generate: redwood_erasure_manifest_20260211.csv, ops_ticket_INF-7421.pdf, and a screenshot-kv-cache-status.png. All artifacts will be zipped and delivered over the DocuSign-protected link you provided (or via secure SFTP if you prefer).

Please confirm the window and your preferred proof delivery method.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — window Wed 02:00-04:00 PST works for us. We prefer the DocuSign-protected delivery for the proof bundle and the manifest. A couple of clarifications from Legal/CISO: 
- Please redact any personally identifiable fragments in screenshots (we only need evidence of cache emptiness).
- For hashes: a manifest with object paths and SHA256 is sufficient; we will not ask for pre-deletion object retrieval.
- We ask that Redwood include an attestation paragraph signed by a Redwood officer included in the bundle.

I will add the Lexicon CISO loop (ciso@lexiconhealth.com) and legal representative for final acceptance. DocuSign link attached in my earlier note.

Jane Doe
Senior Security Analyst
Lexicon Health
